clean.about: A modern product: a calm, credible layout that lets the content lead.
clean.brief: Below the first screen: a `logo-row` or three `stat`s, features as a `grid-3` of `card`s with `icon-badge`s, a `steps` row for how it works, and a closing call to action in `section-soft`. Neutral surfaces with the primary colour only on actions and small highlights; consistent card heights; generous gaps. Avoid: more than one coloured section per screen, centred text in long paragraphs.

soft.about: Warm and friendly: rounded, approachable, for local services, families, wellness and community.
soft.brief: Sections alternate `section` and `section-soft`; features sit in borderless `card`s with `icon-badge`s. Big radii, tinted surfaces, `chip`s for choices, cheerful but specific copy. Avoid: hard lines and dense tables; dark sections.

editorial.about: Magazine-like: serif headlines, long measure, white space, for writers, studios, restaurants and portfolios.
editorial.brief: Content runs in `grid-2` columns with numbered `kicker`s (01, 02…), `menu-item` lists with leaders for menus or price lists, and one large `quote` or a `story`. Thin rules between sections, small uppercase labels, restrained colour (ink and one accent). Avoid: icon badges in grids, shadows, pill buttons.

bold.about: Confident and high-contrast: oversized type and colour blocks, for launches, fitness, events and creative brands.
bold.brief: A `section section-primary` band with a short statement or huge `stat`s, a `bento` of features (one `tall`, one `span-4`), a `timetable` or list in plain form, and a `section-dark` closing call to action. Choose a palette whose primary colour is itself vivid (red, orange, electric blue, magenta), never one whose primary is a grey or brown with the colour only in the accent. Tight tracking, heavy weights, strong contrast between sections, short punchy copy. Avoid: large gradient art panels, many small cards, muted pastels, long paragraphs.

minimal.about: Quiet and airy: hairlines, space and restraint, for premium products, architecture, consultancies and luxury.
minimal.brief: Content is `grid-3` without cards, separated by `rule`s, `kicker` numbers and short lines of text. Monochrome first; the primary colour appears once or twice per screen; hairline borders. Avoid: icon badges, gradients, shadows, more than one button per section.

studio.about: A sharp tech product or startup: gradients, glass and a product shot, the look of a modern software launch.
studio.brief: Follow with a `logo-row`, a `bento` of `glass` tiles with icons and one-line benefits, `steps`, pricing `card`s with the middle one highlighted, and a `section-dark` call to action. Dark palettes suit it well; tight headings, small precise labels, product UI as the picture. Avoid: warm handmade touches, serif type, art panels where a product screen would do.

craft.about: Handmade and local: warm serif headings and menu-board details, for bakeries, cafes, makers, farms and small shops.
craft.brief: Use `menu-item` rows with leaders for products and prices, `chip`s for categories, a `timetable` or `table` of opening hours, an `area-list` or visit-us section with the address. Cream and earthy palettes, small-caps labels, stamp-like `badge`s, friendly specific copy (names, days, prices). Avoid: tech product frames, gradients, bento grids.

playful.about: Bright and playful: chunky shapes, thick outlines and bouncy colour, for kids' parties, games, family apps, toy shops and clubs.
playful.brief: Cards and buttons carry a thick outline and a solid offset shadow; `chip`s and `badge`s in the accent; numbered `steps` with big numerals; sections can switch background colours boldly. Short, warm, exclamation-free copy. Avoid: hairlines, muted greys, long paragraphs.

luxe.about: Luxurious and still: high-contrast serif headings, generous space and fine lines, for salons, fine dining, jewellery, hotels and bespoke services.
luxe.brief: Wide letter-spaced small labels, hairline `rule`s, `menu-item` price lists, a single `quote`, and an appointment form with few fields. Dark palettes or cream with one deep colour; the primary colour as a fine accent only. Avoid: icon badges, bright colours, chunky buttons, more than one call to action per screen.

organic.about: Natural and calm: soft organic shapes and earthy colour, for wellness, gardening, farms, florists, therapists and eco products.
organic.brief: Blob-shaped panels (`media-blob`), leafy greens, sand and clay tones, `check-list`s, a `story` section about the person, an `area-list` for where they work, gentle `faq`. Copy speaks plainly and kindly. Avoid: hard edges, neon, dense grids, dark sections.

retro.about: Retro print: thick borders, offset shadows and poster type, for record shops, barbers, diners, vintage stores and gigs.
retro.brief: Everything has a solid 2–3px outline and a hard offset shadow; `badge`s look like stickers; prices in big type; a `timetable` for gigs or opening hours; colour-blocked `section-primary` bands. Copy with personality. Avoid: gradients, glass, soft shadows, hairlines.

sport.about: Athletic and fast: tall condensed capitals, slanted energy and strong colour, for gyms, coaches, sports clubs, races and outdoor adventures.
sport.brief: Headlines in uppercase condensed type; a `timetable` of sessions; big `stat`s (distances, times, sessions a week); `section-dark` and `section-primary` bands; a sign-up form with few fields. Copy is short and direct. Avoid: serif type, pastel palettes, rounded pill shapes, art panels.

night.about: Night-time and electric: dark backgrounds, glowing accents and wide type, for bars, DJs, clubs, gaming, events and late-night venues.
night.brief: Always a "-dark" palette; `glow` behind the first screen; `timetable` of nights or line-ups; `glass` tiles; prices and dates in the accent. Short, atmospheric copy. Avoid: light sections, serif type, soft pastel cards.

academic.about: Scholarly and organised: serif headings, clear structure and quiet colour, for tutors, schools, courses, research groups and libraries.
academic.brief: A clear `timetable` or course list, `steps` for how it works, `faq`, a `story` about the teacher, small `badge`s for levels, tables where things compare. Navy, forest, burgundy or ink palettes with cream. Copy is precise and reassuring. Avoid: neon, playful shapes, heavy shadows.
